'''jedimaster C of the VG V 1.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile jedimaster DS 2003 CoftheVG.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

NEW COTVG deck. All help welcome!

The published list has 56 cards.

== Strategy ==

Pretty simple to play. Just drop and capture to flip, then feed the RANCOR!

Need something to replace Battle Order with...?

*Card Choices and Combos*

Any Alien + Mandalorian Armor + Hidden Weapons = Pretty obvious

A,A,A = with 20 characters, try to get this out early.

Fear = staple in almost everyone of my DS decks

BF, BH + IG-88 + any other alien = 4 destiny (2 from Fett with any BH, 1 from Iggy with another BH, and 1 from ability).

Any and all suggestions welcome. Thanks Again
